title: Understanding Granularity
text: Granularity refers to the level of detail represented by each row in a dataset.

title: Analyzing the DataFrame
text: Look at the columns and think about what each row in the DataFrame represents.

title: Identifying the Key Element
text: What does each row in the DataFrame correspond to in terms of Angela's social media activity?
